On this page

All add-ons ​

This is the flat catalog — every Sikshya Pro add-on plus every premium gateway, on a single page. Use the Pro add-ons overview for grouped, narrative explanations.

ProEverything below requires Sikshya Pro. Activate a license under Sikshya → License and toggle add-ons on under Sikshya → Add-ons.View pricing →

Which plan unlocks which add-on? ​

Sikshya Pro ships in three tiers. Each add-on lists its minimum tier — anything above unlocks it too.

TierWho it's forHighlights
StarterIndependent creators, single-instructor sitesReviews & ratings, Instructor dashboard, Content drip, Drip emails, Prerequisites, Calendar, all 7 premium gateways
Pro / GrowthSmall academies, paid course shopsEverything in Starter plus Bundles, Subscriptions, Multi-instructor, Live classes, SCORM/H5P, Advanced assignments, Question banks, Gradebook, Advanced certificates, Coupons, Dynamic checkout fields, Social login, Analytics exports, Activity log, Branded delivery, Email customisation, CRM automation, Email marketing sync
ScaleMarketplaces, agencies, enterpriseEverything in Pro / Growth plus Webhooks, Zapier, Public API & API keys, Multi-vendor marketplace, White label, Multisite tools, WPML / Weglot multilingual, Enterprise reporting

Already on a higher tier? Every add-on a lower tier includes is also yours. Check the per-add-on tier label on each card below.

Premium payment gateways ​

Stripe Pro

Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SCA / 3-D Secure 2. Save card for subscription billing.

Setup guide →

Razorpay Pro

Cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets — primary choice for INR.

Setup guide →

Mollie Pro

European-first gateway: iDEAL, Bancontact, SEPA, cards.

Setup guide →

Paystack Pro

Cards, Bank Transfer, USSD, Mobile Money. Primary for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, ZA.

Setup guide →

Square Pro

Cards via Square — useful when you also use Square's POS for in-person classes.

Setup guide →

Authorize.Net Pro

Long-running US gateway. AVS / CVV, recurring tokens.

Setup guide →

Bank Transfer Pro

Manual / wire-transfer flow. Sikshya creates a "Pending payment" order and shows your bank details.

Setup guide →

Build (curriculum & assets) ​

Course bundles Pro

Sell several courses for one bundled price ("bootcamp pack"). Buyers auto-enrolled in every course.

Details →

Course reviews & ratings Pro

Star ratings + written reviews on the course page, with admin moderation. Plan: Starter.

Details →

Course discussions / Q&A Pro

In-course threads + Q&A panel with instructor moderation. Great for cohort programs.

Details →

Multi-instructor & co-authors Pro

Multiple instructors per course (Owner / Editor / Grader). Per-course revenue split.

Details →

Instructor dashboard Pro

Focused home for the Sikshya Instructor role — courses, enrollments, earnings — without exposing wp-admin.

Details →

Live classes (Zoom / Meet) Pro

Pin a Zoom or Google Meet URL to a lesson. Rotate the URL without re-publishing.

Details →

SCORM / H5P Pro

Embed packaged SCORM 1.2 / 2004 content or H5P interactives as a lesson with progress tracked via SCORM API.

Details →

Teach (assessment, automation, journey) ​

Content drip & scheduled unlock Pro

Release lessons by date, X-days-from-enrollment, or cohort start. Plan: Starter.

Details →

Drip & automation emails Pro

"Lesson unlocked", "Course unlocked", weekly digest emails wired to drip rules.

Details →

Prerequisites Pro

Require chosen lessons or whole courses to be completed before the next step unlocks.

Details →

Calendar Pro

Dated schedule on the learner's account — enrollments, drip unlocks, due dates — with REST data.

Details →

Advanced assignments Pro

Rubric grading, restricted file types, resubmissions, queue with filters (ungraded / late / failed).

Details →

Advanced quiz types & banks Pro

Reuse questions from a Question bank. Random pools, randomization, advanced types.

Details →

Gradebook Pro

Per-learner / per-course grades across quizzes & graded assignments. CSV export, drilldown.

Details →

Advanced certificates Pro

Drag-and-drop builder, more merge fields, QR codes, public verify pages.

Details →

Sell (revenue growth) ​

Subscriptions & memberships Pro

Recurring billing — monthly / yearly plans for member-only academy access.

Details →

Advanced coupons & upsells Pro

Min cart total, course / category restrictions, "first-time buyer only", stacking guards.

Details →

Dynamic checkout fields Pro

Configurable checkout questions (text / select / checkbox) with conditional visibility.

Details →

Social login Pro

Sign-in with Google (and other providers). One click instead of password fatigue.

Details →

Operate (analytics, reporting, audit) ​

Advanced analytics & exports Pro

Detailed enrollment / progress / revenue exports for Excel and Sheets, plus learner self-export.

Details →

Student activity log Pro

Timeline of milestones — enrollment, completions, attempts, submissions. Configurable retention.

Details →

Enterprise reporting Pro

Weekly KPI rollup emails for inbox-friendly executive snapshots. Plan: Scale.

Details →

Communicate (email, marketing, automation) ​

Branded email delivery Pro

First-class ESP setup (SendGrid-style) plus a branded multi-template kit (header, footer, accent, logo).

Details →

Email advanced customization Pro

Per-template HTML overrides, extra layout slots, conditional content blocks.

Details →

CRM email automation Pro

Trigger sequences (Day 0 → 3 → 7) on enrollment, completion, abandoned cart.

Details →

Email marketing sync Pro

Sync enrollments / completions to Mailchimp or MailerLite lists / segments automatically.

Details →

Webhooks Pro

Signed JSON to your HTTPS endpoints whenever LMS events fire (purchase, enrollment, completion, certificate). Plan: Scale.

Details →

Zapier Pro

First-class Zapier triggers and actions. Sikshya events fan out into thousands of Zaps. Plan: Scale.

Details →

Public API & API keys Pro

Issue revocable API keys for partners and bespoke integrations. Scoped permissions over REST. Plan: Scale.

Details →

Scale (marketplace, branding, enterprise) ​

Multi-vendor marketplace Pro

Open the academy to many independent vendors — storefronts, per-vendor commission, payouts. Plan: Scale.

Details →

White label & branding Pro

Replace Sikshya labels with your own brand (logo, naming, optional "powered by" toggle). Plan: Scale.

Details →

Multisite & network license Pro

Manage license slots across many subsites of a WordPress multisite network from one place. Plan: Scale.

Details →

Multilingual (WPML / Weglot) Pro

Bridge Sikshya's interface strings into WPML / Weglot translation stacks. Plan: Scale.

Details →

How add-ons turn on ​

  1. Install Sikshya Pro alongside the free Sikshya plugin.
  2. Activate your license in Sikshya → License.
  3. Open Sikshya → Add-ons, search by name or category, click the toggle.
  4. The relevant admin menus / settings panels appear automatically.

Disabling an add-on hides its UI but keeps your data so re-enabling later restores everything.
